# hestiacp_mail_alias (Resource)

Manages an email alias for a HestiaCP mail account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account` (String) Mailbox name the alias points to.
- `alias` (String) Alias address (part before the @).
- `domain` (String) Mail domain.

### Optional

- `user` (String) HestiaCP username. Defaults to the provider `username`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
